title: BORSTAR and AZ DPS Operations (55505196725)
description:
Border Patrol Search, Trauma, and Rescue Unit (BORSTAR) and Arizona Department of Public Safety (AZ DPS) personnel assisting with K9 search operations, September 1, 2026.
Video by AZ DPS

Description: A person wearing a blue long sleeve shirt exits a helicopter on the ground helped by a person outside the aircraft. At :13 a K-9 is helped out of the helicopter by the two people outside the helicopter and one person still inside. At :17 the third person, wearing a camouflage uniform with the words POLICE in yellow on their back exits the helicopter and takes the dog's harness
